snippet.title: VAMP Performance Evidence Desk: proof before promises
snippet.description:
Performance review panic starts when evidence was never collected as evidence.

Proof: A controlled private proof mapped 190 evidence records to performance objectives, retained review candidates and exposed evidence gaps without making a rating decision.

Request one task-agreement and evidence snapshot pilot.
